inputs.text: That “routine border policy” explanation is doing a lot of work. Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026, and officials are already talking about “strengthening” the system—while Nigerians and others are being put in the crosshairs. The timing looks like a coordinated clampdown being sold as mere administration, and the people who stand to benefit are still kept out of view. Don’t mistake the official wording for the whole story.
